functions.name: current_user_can_manage_whatsapp
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.current_user_can_manage_whatsapp(p_lead_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles p
    left join public.leads l on l.id = p_lead_id
    where p.user_id = (select auth.uid())
      and p.active = true
      and (
        p.role::text in ('admin', 'supervisor')
        or (p.role::text = 'seller' and l.assigned_seller_user_id = p.user_id)
      )
  );
$function$

functions.name: set_whatsapp_conversation_mode
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_whatsapp_conversation_mode(p_lead_id uuid, p_mode text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_user_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_control public.whatsapp_conversation_controls%rowtype;
begin
  if v_user_id is null or not private.current_user_can_manage_whatsapp(p_lead_id) then
    raise exception 'No tenés permiso para intervenir esta conversación';
  end if;
  if p_mode not in ('ai', 'human') then
    raise exception 'El modo de conversación no es válido';
  end if;

  insert into public.whatsapp_conversation_controls (
    lead_id,
    mode,
    taken_by_user_id,
    taken_at,
    released_by_user_id,
    released_at
  ) values (
    p_lead_id,
    p_mode,
    case when p_mode = 'human' then v_user_id else null end,
    case when p_mode = 'human' then now() else null end,
    case when p_mode = 'ai' then v_user_id else null end,
    case when p_mode = 'ai' then now() else null end
  )
  on conflict (lead_id) do update set
    mode = excluded.mode,
    taken_by_user_id = excluded.taken_by_user_id,
    taken_at = excluded.taken_at,
    released_by_user_id = excluded.released_by_user_id,
    released_at = excluded.released_at
  returning * into v_control;

  insert into public.whatsapp_conversation_events (lead_id, actor_user_id, event_type)
  values (p_lead_id, v_user_id, case when p_mode = 'human' then 'taken' else 'released' end);

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'lead_id', v_control.lead_id,
    'mode', v_control.mode,
    'taken_by_user_id', v_control.taken_by_user_id,
    'taken_at', v_control.taken_at,
    'released_at', v_control.released_at,
    'updated_at', v_control.updated_at
  );
end;
$function$

human_channel.query:
select jsonb_build_object(
 'captured_at', clock_timestamp(),
 'functions', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',p.proname,'identity_arguments',pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'owner',r.rolname,'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'config',p.proconfig,'acl',p.proacl::text,'anon_execute',has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'authenticated_execute',has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'service_role_execute',has_function_privilege('service_role',p.oid,'EXECUTE')) order by n.nspname,p.proname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace join pg_roles r on r.oid=p.proowner where (n.nspname='private' and p.proname='current_user_can_manage_whatsapp') or (n.nspname='public' and p.proname='set_whatsapp_conversation_mode')),
 'policies',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',schemaname,'table',tablename,'name',policyname,'roles',roles,'command',cmd,'using',qual,'with_check',with_check) order by tablename,policyname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_policies where schemaname='public' and tablename in ('leads','lead_messages','whatsapp_conversation_controls','whatsapp_conversation_events')),
 'channel_event_usage',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by event_type,actor_role),'[]'::jsonb) from (select e.event_type,coalesce(p.role::text,'missing_profile') actor_role,p.active actor_currently_active,count(*) event_count,count(distinct e.actor_user_id) distinct_actor_count,min(e.created_at) first_event_at,max(e.created_at) last_event_at from public.whatsapp_conversation_events e left join public.profiles p on p.user_id=e.actor_user_id group by e.event_type,p.role,p.active) x),
 'channel_message_usage',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by origin,direction),'[]'::jsonb) from (select origin,direction,count(*) message_count,min(created_at) first_message_at,max(created_at) last_message_at from public.lead_messages where origin='human' group by origin,direction) x),
 'conversation_control_counts',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by mode),'[]'::jsonb) from (select mode,count(*) controls_count,count(*) filter(where last_human_message_at is not null) with_last_human_message_count from public.whatsapp_conversation_controls group by mode) x)
) as capture;

 'other_privileged_role_count',(select count(*) from pg_roles where (rolsuper or rolbypassrls) and rolname not in ('postgres','supabase_admin','service_role','authenticator','supabase_auth_admin','supabase_storage_admin','supabase_replication_admin','dashboard_user')),
 'current_session_groups',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by database_role,application_class,state),'[]'::jsonb) from (select case when usename in ('postgres','supabase_admin','service_role','authenticator','supabase_auth_admin','supabase_storage_admin','supabase_replication_admin','dashboard_user','pgbouncer','pgsodium_keyholder') then usename else 'other_role_hash:'||md5(coalesce(usename,'')) end database_role,case when application_name='' then 'empty' when application_name in ('PostgREST','postgrest','pg_cron','supabase_admin','postgres_exporter','realtime','Supavisor') then application_name else 'other_application_hash:'||md5(application_name) end application_class,state,count(*) session_count from pg_stat_activity where datname=current_database() group by 1,2,3) x),
 'foreign_server_count',(select count(*) from pg_foreign_server),
